 Match Preview
 Africa Cup of Nations Qualification - Game Week 4 Nov 17, 2026 - 08:00 Gambia host Ivory Coast in Africa Cup of Nations Qualification, with Les Éléphants looking to build on their recent meeting between these two sides.
 Ivory Coast arrive in confident shape under Hervé Renard, having already beaten Gambia in the reverse fixture and sitting top of Group C heading into this match.
 Gambia, coached by Johnny McKinstry, are second in the group and will need a positive result to keep pace with their opponents at the summit.
 The Scorpions have shown they can compete at this level, winning back-to-back qualification matches against Ghana and Somalia in September, but their head-to-head record against Ivory Coast makes for difficult reading.
 For Ivory Coast, this is a chance to consolidate their position and maintain momentum after a productive qualification campaign that has seen them win three of their last five matches across all competitions.
 Renard's side also carry the experience of a World Cup appearance in 2026, which adds a layer of quality and tournament hardening that Gambia will need to account for.
